# Hitesh Patil

> Machine Learning Engineer and Backend Developer specializing in applied machine learning models, edge computer vision, distributed systems, and geospatial routing architectures.

Hitesh Patil (handle: TheGoodDevil00) is a software engineer focused on architecting intelligent, safety-aware applications and high-throughput backend services. With a background spanning autonomous multi-drone systems, computer vision on edge devices, and geospatial navigation pipelines, he builds performant solutions from data modeling to production deployment.

## Core Specializations

- **Applied Machine Learning & Edge AI**: Real-time object detection (YOLO11n), model optimization, feature engineering, and edge inference on hardware like Raspberry Pi 5.
- **Geospatial Engineering & Routing**: Multi-criteria routing systems with Valhalla, PostGIS spatial queries, Uber H3 hexagonal spatial indexing, and OSMnx data ingestion.
- **Backend Architecture & Distributed Telemetry**: Scalable microservices, REST APIs, UDP telemetry pipelines (MAVLink protocol), and real-time database subscriptions.
- **Modern Full-Stack Development**: Next.js (App Router, Turbopack), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, PostgreSQL, and Supabase.

## Featured Projects

- [WalkSafe – Routing System](https://thegooddevil.space/projects): End-to-end geospatial navigation system prioritizing pedestrian safety over shortest-path routing. Features an OSM-derived safety scoring engine, PostGIS/H3 indexing, self-hosted Valhalla routing, and a Flutter mobile app with live SOS alerting. (Repository: https://github.com/TheGoodDevil00/WalkSafe)
- [Mission Overlay – Drone GCS](https://thegooddevil.space/projects): Unified multi-vehicle Ground Control Station (GCS) for autonomous drone fleet coordination. Implements live MAVLink telemetry ingestion over UDP, real-time GPS tracking, artificial horizon flight instruments, and an autonomous waypoint partitioning wizard interoperable with ArduPilot and Mission Planner. (Repository: https://github.com/TheGoodDevil00/mission-planner-interface)
- [ML & Data Analysis Systems](https://thegooddevil.space/projects): Production-ready machine learning pipelines and EDA suites spanning NYC Taxi, housing, and tabular benchmarks. Built with Scikit-learn, Pandas, FastAPI, and Streamlit. (Demo: https://nyc-taxi-dataset-production-bf51.up.railway.app/)
- [Ignite 2.0 – Realtime Tournament Infrastructure](https://thegooddevil.space/projects): Real-time competitive tournament management platform featuring live score synchronization, on-the-fly tie-breaking via Postgres change streams, and a Dark Stadium interface built with Next.js and Supabase. (Demo: https://ignite-2-0.vercel.app)
- [Askew – High-Performance Frontend Experience](https://thegooddevil.space/projects): High-performance interactive UI system replacing static-heavy assets with component-driven rendering for low-latency web experiences. (Demo: https://askew-lovat.vercel.app/)

## Professional Experience & Leadership

- **Team Lead – NIDAR 2027 RescueSwarm** (Current): Leading a 10-member engineering team developing an autonomous multi-drone system for the NIDAR 2027 Track 1 Drone Innovation challenge (autonomous search, survivor geotagging, and aid delivery). Leads edge computer vision pipeline (YOLO11n on Raspberry Pi 5) and the mission-critical Ground Control Station interface.
- **AI/ML Cohort Member – Catalyst Tech Club** (Current): Active contributor to applied ML projects, exploratory data analysis frameworks, and technical peer mentorship (~40 hrs/week dedicated to systems and AI research).
